text:
maya-platform: heads-up: deploybot blocked v6.0.0 EU due to missing SBOM attach + vuln scan reports 1 LOW transitive CVE (build-only). change window in ~40m. quick suggestions?

deploybot: [automated] release v6.0.0 -> gates: SBOM_ATTACHMENT: MISSING; VULN_SCAN: 1 LOW (transitive, build-only). Action: HOLD (region=eu-west-1). See pipeline /pipelines/20021.

olivia-sec: Need cosign output + SBOM checksum. If CVE truly build-only we can consider a timeboxed exception for a tiny EU canary, with compliance evidence.

rafi-build: Confirmed: `cosign verify registry.redwood/v6.0.0` -> `error: no signatures found` but SBOM file exists in artifacts store at s3://build-sboms/v6.0.0/sbom.json. It wasn't pushed as manifest annotation due to a bug in publish step.

joey-release: Ops options: (A) defer EU and roll everywhere else now, (B) attach SBOM and run 1% EU canary with strict monitor, (C) rollback to v5.9.8. We have a 40m window so (B) or (A) preferred.

maya-platform: I can assemble evidence bundle and open CHG. Command I ran: ```bash
registry-cli fetch-manifest registry.redwood/v6.0.0 > manifest.json
aws s3 cp s3://build-sboms/v6.0.0/sbom.json ./sbom.json
cosign verify registry.redwood/v6.0.0 > cosign.out || true
sha256sum sbom.json > sbom.sha256
```

rafi-build: I've prepared a hotfix to the publisher to re-annotate the manifest on retry. PR #772: https://git.redwood/infra/publish/pull/772. If merged, we can re-publish and attach sbom in ~15m.

olivia-sec: Compliance conditional: we'll allow a 1% EU canary for up to 24h if you: 1) upload evidence bundle to CHG ticket, 2) tag release `v6.0.0-eu-timebox-exc`, 3) set automated rollback to v5.9.8 at 24h if remediation not merged, and 4) monitor security telemetry every 5m for first 2h. Post final sign-off when cosign verify shows SBOM signature.

joey-release: Creating CHG-4333 and uploading evidence. If PR #772 merges I'll re-run publish and post cosign output to CHG. Setting region allowlist to skip EU until we have conditional.

maya-platform: Evidence uploaded: https://internal.redwood/chg/CHG-4333/evidence.tar.gz. Release note draft: "v6.0.0: EU limited canary due to SBOM annotation delay; LOW transitive CVE in build-only tooling; publisher PR #772 opened; auto-rollback scheduled +24h."

rafi-build: PR #772 merged. Re-publishing now. Will paste cosign verify shortly.

deploybot: [automated] re-evaluation queued after publish. If cosign verify shows signature + sbom annotation, EU gate will auto-unblock per CHG attestation.

rafi-build: `cosign verify registry.redwood/v6.0.0` -> `Verified signed by key: projects/prod/sbom-key; annotations: io.redwood.sbom present`. Pushed cosign.out to CHG-4333.

olivia-sec: Verified cosign output on CHG-4333. Posting sign-off :white_check_mark: Proceed with 1% EU canary, tag `v6.0.0-eu-timebox-exc`. Keep monitoring cadence at 5m for 2h.

joey-release: Starting limited EU canary now. Deploybot will enforce 24h auto-rollback guard to v5.9.8 if remediation not present or if security telemetry triggers.

deploybot: [automated] action: proceed rollout -> regions: global-except-eu (full), eu-west-1 (1% canary). policy: timebox 24h; auto-rollback target v5.9.8 if SBOM not verified or thresholds crossed.

maya-platform: thanks team — monitoring dashboards up and will post any anomalies.

olivia-sec: Reminder: after 2h if no anomalies, we can increment EU to 10% then to full per standard ramp. Keep CHG updated.
